name: brokerage_order_place
title: Place a real order — trades money
description: Places a live equity order in the market using a confirmation token obtained from brokerage_order_preview. This spends the customer's money and creates market exposure; it cannot be undone once it fills. Use when the customer has seen a preview of this exact order and explicitly told you to place it, and only then: brokerage_order_preview must have returned a confirmationToken for the same order first. Do not use to check whether an order is possible — call brokerage_order_check. Do not use to show the customer what an order would cost — call brokerage_order_preview. Do not re-invoke after a rejection or a declined approval without the customer explicitly asking again. Every call requires an idempotencyKey: a fresh one for a genuinely new order, and the same one when retrying an order whose outcome is unknown, which returns the original result rather than placing a second order. If the call times out, the order may still have been placed: call brokerage_orders_list before doing anything else, and never assume failure. A successful result means the order was accepted, not that it filled — check status and isTerminal, and tell the customer which of the two happened.

accountId.description: The account to trade in, from brokerage_accounts_list. Must match the account the preview was run against.

confirmationToken.description: Token from brokerage_order_preview, valid for 120 seconds and single use. It binds this order to the outcome the customer was shown.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID identifying this order attempt. Use a new one for a new order; reuse the same one to retry an attempt whose outcome is unknown.

symbol.description: Ticker to trade, uppercase. Must match the preview.

side.description: Direction. SELL_SHORT opens a short position and BUY_TO_COVER closes one; they are not interchangeable with SELL and BUY.

quantity.description: Whole shares. Fractional quantities are not supported. Must match the preview.

orderType.description: How to price the order. MARKET executes immediately at whatever the market offers, which in a fast market may be materially worse than the last price shown.

limitPrice.description: Required for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT. The worst price the customer will accept. Omit for MARKET and STOP orders.

stopPrice.description: Required for STOP and STOP_LIMIT. The price at which the order activates. Omit for MARKET and LIMIT orders.

timeInForce.description: How long the order stays live. Omitted means DAY, which expires at the close of the current session.

extendedHours.description: Allow execution outside regular hours, where spreads are wider and liquidity thinner. Omitted means false. Only valid with LIMIT orders.

reason.description: Why the customer is placing this order, in their own words where available. Captured verbatim in the audit record. Omitted when the customer has not given a reason; do not invent one.

orderId.description: Identifier of the order just placed. Pass to brokerage_order_get to follow its progress.

status.description: Lifecycle state immediately after acceptance. Usually NEW or PARTIALLY_FILLED, occasionally FILLED for a marketable order.

isTerminal.description: True only if the order completed instantly. Usually false: acceptance is not execution.

statusExplanation.description: One sentence for the customer describing what has and has not happened yet.

replayed.description: True when this result was replayed from a previous call with the same idempotencyKey — no new order was placed.

summary.description: One-line description of the order as placed, suitable for reading back to the customer.
